label: Bible Study
prompt: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I _____ him out of the water.
verse: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
note: Pharaoh's daughter names the baby from the basket — Moses, because she drew him out of the water.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: They shall not _____ nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
verse: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
note: No hunger, no thirst, no scorching sun — God leads His people by springs of water.

label: Sunday School
prompt: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden _____, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.
verse: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.
note: Approaching the king uninvited meant death — unless he held out the golden sceptre. Esther had not been called in thirty days.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And hope maketh not _____; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verse: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
note: The end of Paul's chain from tribulation to hope: this hope won't embarrass you, because God's love is already poured in.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: So we fasted and _____ our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
verse: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
note: Ezra was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers (8:22), so the people fasted and 'besought' God instead — and he listened.
